scope: Explicit local verification of an existing editor draft and its two mask PNGs against the current staged target; no automatic registration or quality approval
compatibility: Keep agemorph3d-mask-editor-v1 export format and the original mask-editor-v1 protocol unchanged. Explicit user-selected import is not automatic restoration

inputs.selection: User chooses draft JSON, allowed L8 PNG, and occluded L8 PNG, then explicitly starts local verification. A current session stage and previously verified target PNG are required
inputs.json: Bound UTF8 size before parse, reject repeated keys including escaped aliases, unknown or missing fields, malformed versions/status/coordinate rule, nonfinite/overflow geometry, invalid metadata, counts, hashes or flags
inputs.binding: Exact current stage_id, source_fingerprint, target_condition, generated_sha256 and fit_sha256; verify the current target PNG again. Offline declarations are not a signature, permission or live-stage proof
inputs.mask_files: Snapshot bounded bytes before asynchronous work; verify original file bytes and SHA256 against the draft, CRC/chunk order, native grayscale color0/8bit/no-interlace format, bounded decoded length, binary pixels and exact raster equivalence to the exported polygons
inputs.compression: Decode uploaded bytes and compare pixels; never re-encode and require the same deflate bytes
inputs.geometry: Reuse the editor native pixel-center rule and existing polygon limits; occlusion wins, unknown stays zero in both files; refuse empty or all-allowed exports

workflow.success: Publish all verified reviewer fields and mask snapshots atomically, show local verification status, and enable only the existing explicit register action
workflow.submission: When a draft remains selected, registration requires its current validated snapshot. Submit the verified immutable File copies, not a later reread of selected disk files. Manual input remains available after explicit draft removal
workflow.failure: No partial reviewer fields or stale imported masks may remain eligible. Current source/stage can remain available; do not call registration
workflow.invalidation: Changing JSON, either mask, reviewer fields, condition, stage, source, service, cancel, stage-expired response or pagehide invalidates imported status. Changing import files clears imported reviewer fields; changed metadata requires re-verification or explicit draft removal
workflow.async: Check operation generation, stage/target identity, file selection identities and import epoch before publishing; obsolete asynchronous work cannot refill fields or submit
workflow.network: Import verification is local only. No health, stage or register request is sent by the import action. Existing server TTL/session ownership remains authoritative on later explicit submission
workflow.persistence: No localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, remote uploads, automatic draft loading or quality acceptance records

acceptance.unit: Valid old-export roundtrip, strict JSON/flags, all binding fields, independent grayscale filters, CRC/length/format/binary/raster/count/hash negatives, input bounds, snapshots and async mutation
acceptance.browser: Synthetic local session and target only; installed Chrome and Edge; explicit file import, no POST during verification, later explicit register uses snapshots, mismatch/failed import, changed files/reviewer, cancellation, stage replacement and pagehide. Freeze source, input and harness hashes before each browser run
acceptance.limits: Synthetic engineering verification is not real SAM/model execution, actual manual review, stable-browser real-service display, current-render identity validation or independent evaluation
